outcome: Enlargement rate of uterine size per year
cohort: Patients diagnosed with adenomyosis by magnetic resonance imaging between 2015 and 2022 at The University of Tokyo Hospital. The pregnancy group included patients who experienced pregnancy and delivery between the first and second imaging examinations. The control group included patients who did not experience pregnancy, hormonal treatment, or surgery (except cesarean section).
finding: Pregnancy was associated with a reduced enlargement rate of uterine size in women with adenomyosis compared to those who did not experience pregnancy.
